# Forging Nails Salon & Beauty

> Russian manicure studio based in Georgetown, Texas. Russian manicures, gel manicures and Russian pedicures in a private, industrial-style studio at Salon Lofts in Wolf Ranch. Niki never rushes, works with odorless European gels and puts the health of your natural nails first.

## Services
- Russian manicure: From $120, 2-3 hours. Meticulous e-file and cuticle-scissor prep, a structured gel overlay and European gel polish. Lasts three to five weeks.
- Gel manicure: From $85, 90 minutes. A modern e-file manicure with odorless, TPO-free European gel. Add chrome or cat eye for $25.
- Russian pedicure: From $130, 2-3 hours. A waterless e-file pedicure in a zero-gravity, full-body massage chair, with a drink to sip.

## About
Forging Nails Salon & Beauty is Niki Burnett's private, industrial-style studio inside Salon Lofts at Wolf Ranch Town Center, on W University Ave in Georgetown. One chair, one client, a modern industrial look with a cozy boutique feel: the opposite of a busy nail bar. Niki started in the beauty industry in Toledo, Ohio, then spent years in New York City, where hospitality shaped her love of elevated service and thoughtful details. New York is also where she fell for metalworking. She loves to weld and forge, hence the name. After moving to Georgetown to be closer to family, she opened a studio of her own. She is certified in Russian manicures and dry e-file pedicures. Every visit starts with a consultation, she works with odorless, TPO-free European gels, and clients notice the difference: no chemical smell, cleaner cuticles and nails that grow out long and strong. Pedicures happen in a zero-gravity massage chair, often with a drink to sip.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What is a Russian manicure?
  A: A precise manicure built around detailed cuticle work with an electric file and cuticle scissors, finished with a structured gel overlay and European gel polish. It looks exceptionally clean, protects the natural nail and lasts three to five weeks, so most clients come back about once a month.
- Q: How much does a Russian manicure cost?
  A: A Russian manicure starts at $120 (2-3 hours), a gel manicure at $85 (90 minutes) and a mini manicure at $55. Chrome or cat eye adds $25, and first-time services add $25. See the full menu on the Services page.
- Q: What is a Russian pedicure?
  A: A waterless pedicure done with an e-file: detailed cuticle clean-up, callus removal, an essential-oil sugar scrub, hot towels and a foot massage, all in a zero-gravity, full-body massage chair. It starts at $130.
- Q: Where is the studio, and when are you open?
  A: Inside Salon Lofts at Wolf Ranch: 1019 W University Ave, Bldg 310, Suite #105, Georgetown, TX 78628. Tuesday to Friday 10 am to 8 pm, Saturday 10 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday and Monday. By appointment.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through Vagaro or call (512) 966-2784. Appointments are one-on-one, so booking ahead is best.
- Q: I need extra time or a different seat. Can you help?
  A: Yes. Mention it when you book. Niki has scheduled extra time for clients who can't sit in a regular manicure chair.
